item.title: MB Takes the Mic at Busan Market, Urges "Choose Park Hyung-joon" (부산 시장서 마이크 잡은 MB “박형준 선택해 달라”)
item.description:
MB Takes the Mic at Busan Market, Urges "Choose Park Hyung-joon" (부산 시장서 마이크 잡은 MB “박형준 선택해 달라”)

On May 31, three days ahead of the June 3 local elections, former President Lee Myung-bak visited Busan to campaign for People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon. <<> At around 1:30 p.m. that day, the former President visited Haeundae Market in Haeundae-gu, Busan, alongside candidate Park, greeting merchants and citizens. They chanted "Lee Myung-bak" and welcomed the former President. <<> At the event, the former President stated, "I've been through many elections myself, but I came here with a special affection for the Busan mayoral election," adding, "This is also the first time I've picked up a microphone for this June 3 election." Candidate Park is considered a key figure among pro-Lee Myung-bak factions. <<> He continued, "Everyone, you know I served as Seoul Mayor, right? What I felt while being mayor is that a mayor who gets things done is necessary." He said, "We don't need politicians who just talk; we need to elect a mayor who truly works for Busan to develop," and added, "Mayor Park Hyung-joon is now leading Busan toward a future-oriented development." <<> The former President urged support for candidate Park, saying, "If Busan develops, it, along with Seoul, will form the two pillars for South Korea's development. For Busan to develop, ongoing work must be continued and finished. That's why Mayor Park Hyung-joon should remain in office." <<> Present at the event were People Power Party lawmakers Kim Dae-sik, Kim Mi-ae, Lee Seong-kwon, Jeong Dong-man, and Joo Jin-woo, who represent Busan districts, along with former Emergency Response Committee Chairman Hwang Woo-yeo and Busan Haeundae-gu district office candidate Kim Seong-su. <<> Earlier, the former President had lunch of pork soup (dwaeji-gukbap) with candidate Park at a pork soup restaurant near Haeundae-gu, Busan. Also present was Park Min-shik, a candidate running in the by-election for the Busan Buk-gu district National Assembly seat. Candidate Park relayed that the former President told him, "Fight to the end. If a good person fights a bad person, they must win. You will surely win." (6·3 지방선거를 사흘 앞둔 31일 이명박 전 대통령이 부산을 찾아 국민의힘 박형준 부산시장 후보 지원 유세에 나섰다.)

item.title: 60 Trillion Won Submarine Project Bidding War... Kang Hoon-sik Departs for Canada (60조 잠수함 사업 수주전... 강훈식, 캐나다로 출국)
item.description:
60 Trillion Won Submarine Project Bidding War... Kang Hoon-sik Departs for Canada (60조 잠수함 사업 수주전... 강훈식, 캐나다로 출국)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik departed for Canada on the 31st as a special envoy for strategic economic cooperation on behalf of President Lee Jae-myung. With the selection of a contractor for Canada's next-generation submarine project (CPSP), estimated to be worth up to 60 trillion won, just a month away, he is expected to launch a full-court press to support Korean companies' bid for the contract locally. (강훈식 대통령 비서실장이 31일 이재명 대통령의 전략경제협력 특사 자격으로 캐나다로 출국했다. 최대 60조원으로 추산되는 캐나다 차세대 잠수함(CPSP) 사업자 선정이 한 달 앞으로 다가온 가운데, 현지에서 우리 기업의 수주를 위한 막판 총력 지원에 나설 것으로 보인다.)

Chief Kang announced on Facebook that day that he was leaving for Canada along with officials from the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and companies and organizations in the energy, resources, supply chain, and advanced industries sectors. "As confirmed during the summit phone call between the two countries on the 8th, the South Korea-Canada relationship is rapidly expanding across the economy, energy, and advanced industries," Kang said. "I am particularly aware that, amid the prolonged situation in the Middle East, the economic and industrial structures of the two countries are complementary, and the synergy of cooperation as middle powers is very significant." <<> He added, "As this is our second special envoy visit in four months, I will do my utmost to achieve tangible results that can expand strategic cooperation between the two countries in the fields of energy, resources, supply chains, and advanced industries." (강 실장은 이날 페이스북을 통해 산업통상부·외교부, 에너지·자원·공급망·첨단산업 분야 기업 및 단체들과 함께 캐나다로 떠난다고 밝혔다. 강 실장은 “지난 8일 양국 정상 통화에서도 확인했듯, 한-캐나다 관계는 경제·에너지·첨단산업 전반으로 빠르게 넓어지고 있다”며 “특히 중동 사태가 길어지는 상황에서 양국의 경제·산업 구조가 상호보완적이며, 글로벌 중견국으로서 협력의 시너지가 매우 크다는 점을 실감하고 있다”고 했다.)

In political circles, there are expectations that ahead of the selection of the CPSP contractor, anticipated at the end of next month, Chief Kang will attend the 'Korea-Canada Resource Security and Supply Chain Cooperation Forum' held locally to provide support for Korean companies. Currently, the 'One Team' of Korea's Hanwha Ocean and HD Hyundai Heavy Industries is competing fiercely against Germany's TKMS in a full-scale national effort. <<>> (이어 “4개월 만의 두 번째 특사 방문인 만큼 에너지·자원·공급망·첨단산업 분야에서 양국 간 전략적 협력을 확대할 수 있는 실질적 성과를 거둘 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cousin Uses Relative’s ID for Early Voting… Election Commission: "A Mix-Up Due to Similar Looks" (사촌 신분증 내고 사전 투표… 선관위 “닮은 외모로 벌어진 해프닝”)
item.description:
Cousin Uses Relative’s ID for Early Voting… Election Commission: "A Mix-Up Due to Similar Looks" (사촌 신분증 내고 사전 투표… 선관위 “닮은 외모로 벌어진 해프닝” )

At an early voting station in Daegu, a younger cousin cast a ballot using her older sister’s identification. The issue was discovered within 10 minutes, and both individuals were eventually able to vote properly. (대구의 한 사전 투표소에서 사촌 동생이 언니 신분증으로 투표하는 일이 벌어졌다. 10분 만에 문제가 발견돼 두 사람 모두 정상적으로 투표를 할 수 있게 됐다.)

According to the Daegu City Election Commission on the 31st, Ms. A arrived at a polling station in Daegu around 9:30 a.m. on the first day of early voting, the 29th, accompanied by her older cousin Ms. B, who had mobility difficulties, and a caregiver. Ms. B used a walking aid due to her limited mobility, and Ms. A, carrying Ms. B’s ID, arrived at the station first. (31일 대구시선거관리위원회에 따르면, A씨는 사전 투표 첫날인 지난 29일 오전 9시 30분쯤 거동이 불편한 사촌 언니 B씨, 요양보호사와 함께 대구 한 사전 투표소로 향했다. B씨는 보행 보조 기구를 끌고 다닐 정도로 거동이 불편했고, 이에 B씨의 신분증까지 가지고 먼저 투표소에 도착했다.)

Ms. A then presented Ms. B’s ID instead of her own, went through identity verification, and completed her vote. The issue arose afterward. About 10 minutes later, Ms. B entered the polling station with her caregiver, but it appeared she had already voted. (이후 투표소를 찾았던 A씨는 자신의 신분증이 아닌 B씨 신분증을 낸 뒤 신원 확인 절차를 거쳐 투표를 마쳤다. 문제는 이후 발생했다. 10분가량 뒤 B씨가 요양보호사와 함께 투표소로 입장했지만 이미 투표를 마친 것으로 나온 것이다.)

The Election Commission reviewed CCTV footage and other evidence to investigate the matter. During the investigation, Ms. A explained that she had mistakenly submitted the wrong ID. Additionally, Ms. B’s ID had been issued over 20 years ago, making the photo blurry, and since the two women shared a similar address and appearance, the election staff reportedly failed to recognize that the ID belonged to a different person during the verification process. (선관위 측은 CCTV 확인 등을 통해 사실 확인에 나섰으며, 선관위 조사에서 A씨는 “신분증을 잘못 제출했다”는 취지로 설명했다고 한다. 또 B씨의 신분증은 20여 년 전 발급돼 사진 등이 흐릿했고 A씨와 주소가 비슷한 데다 외모까지 닮아 선거 사무원이 본인 확인 과정에서 다른 사람이라는 점을 인지하지 못한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Election Commission also noted that while fingerprint recognition is used during early voting, it is intended only to confirm participation in the election, not to verify the voter’s identity, and thus cannot determine if the voter matches the ID. (또 사전 선거 때 지문 인식이 이뤄지지만, 이는 투표자 본인 확인 여부가 아니라 투표 참여 여부 확인용이라 본인 여부를 가려내지 못했다고 선관위는 설명했다.)

A Daegu City Election Commission official stated, "We have taken measures to ensure Ms. B can exercise her voting rights, and we have also ensured that Ms. A, who already voted, cannot cast an additional ballot at another early voting station or on election day. Regarding fingerprint recognition, it serves the same purpose as a signature in the voter list during the main election—it’s for voting confirmation and not designed to verify whether the ID and the voter match." (대구시선관위 관계자는 “B씨가 본인의 투표권을 행사할 수 있도록 조치를 마쳤고, 이미 투표를 마친 A씨는 다른 사전 투표소나 본투표에서 추가 투표를 하지 못하도록 조치했다”며 “지문 인식의 경우 본선거 때 선거인 명부 책자에 본인이 서명하는 것과 같은 투표 확인용이라 이를 통해 신분증과 투표자 일치 여부를 확인할 수는 없는 구조”라고 말했다.)

item.title: This Time, "Give a Kiss" to a Baby...Ruling Party Yangcheon District Head Candidate Apologizes Amid Controversy (이번엔 아기에 “뽀뽀해봐”... 與 양천구청장 후보, 논란 일자 “사과”)
item.description:
Woo Hyung-chan, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Yangcheon District head, who sparked controversy by telling a baby to "give a kiss" during a campaign rally for the June 3 local elections, said on the 31st, "I deeply apologize to the baby and parents who suffered emotional wounds and discomfort, as well as to the residents of Yangcheon District who must have been disappointed." <<>>> On that day, during a campaign event in Mok-dong, Yangcheon-gu, Seoul, Candidate Woo said to a baby held in the arms of Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party's Seoul mayoral candidate, "One kiss" and "Kiss." In response, Lim Se-eun, a senior deputy spokesperson for the Democratic Party standing nearby, blocked the action. This scene was captured on camera and spread online. (6·3 지방선거 유세 중 아기에게 “뽀뽀해”라고 말해 논란을 빚은 우형찬 더불어민주당 양천구청장 후보가 31일 “마음의 상처와 불편함을 겪으신 아기와 부모님, 실망하셨을 양천구민 여러분께 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다.)

In response, the People Power Party criticized it as "forcing a kiss." Ham In-kyung, a spokesperson for the People Power Party's central election committee, referenced an earlier incident where Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae told a young girl to "try calling me oppa" during a campaign speech supporting Ha Jung-woo, the Busan North District candidate, calling it "a bizarre political culture that forces young children to say 'oppa' and demands 'kisses.'" (우 후보는 이날 서울 양천구 목동 유세 현장에서 정원오 민주당 서울시장 후보가 품에 안은 아기를 향해 “뽀뽀 한번” “뽀뽀”라고 말했다. 이에 옆에 서 있던 임세은 민주당 선임부대변인이 이를 막았다. 이 장면은 카메라에 찍혀 인터넷으로 퍼졌다.)

Candidate Woo posted on his blog that day, stating, "There is no excuse for my careless and thoughtless remarks during the campaign rally today," and "Addressing a baby I met on the scene with words like 'kiss, give a kiss' was my fault for treating the child from an adult's unilateral perspective, while pretending to meet them at their level." (이에 대해 국민의힘은 ‘뽀뽀 강요’라며 비판했다. 함인경 국민의힘 중앙선대위 대변인은 앞서 정청래 민주당 대표가 하정우 부산 북갑 후보 지원 유세에서 여아에게 ‘오빠라고 해보라’고 했던 것을 거론하며 “어린아이에게 ‘오빠’를 강요하고 ‘뽀뽀’를 요구하는 기괴한 정치문화”라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Not Voting Gives an Opportunity to Those Who Abuse Power"... Opposition: "Dividing the People" (李 “투표 안하면 권력 남용하는 자에 기회”… 野 “국민 갈라치기”)
item.description:
Amid ongoing controversy over President Lee Jae-myung allegedly exposing his ballot while voting early in the June 3 local elections, President Lee posted messages on X for two consecutive days encouraging voter turnout without addressing the issue. President Lee stated, "Abstaining from voting gives an opportunity to those who deceive the people and abuse power," adding, "If there is a political group uncomfortable with this statement, they are the ones stuck in old vested interests." The People Power Party countered, "While it outwardly appears to encourage voter participation, it is actually a message aimed at inducing negative perceptions of a specific political force," calling it "a blatant election interference that forgets the president's duty of political neutrality." (이재명 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 사전 투표를 하면서 투표지를 노출했다는 논란이 계속되는 가운데, 이 대통령은 이에 대한 언급 없이 X에 이틀 연속 글을 올려 투표를 독려했다. 이 대통령은 “투표 포기는 국민을 속이고 권력을 남용하는 자들에게 기회를 주는 것”이라며 “이 말이 불편한 정치 집단이 있다면 그들이 바로 구태 기득권자”라고 했다. 국민의힘은 “겉으로는 투표 참여를 독려하는 것처럼 보이지만 실제로는 특정 정치 세력에 대한 부정적 인식을 유도하는 메시지”라며 “대통령의 정치적 중립 의무를 망각한 노골적인 선거 개입”이라고 반발했다.)

On the morning of the 31st, three days before the main voting day, President Lee wrote on X, quoting the ancient philosopher Plato: "The price of political apathy is being ruled by the worst scum." He further cited Plato's words, "The greatest punishment for good people who refuse to govern is to be governed by those worse than themselves." President Lee said, "Depending on the mindset and attitude of elected officials, the world can become hell or heaven," and "The power of the vote is stronger than you think. Whether those elected become loyal servants enriching our lives or malignant rulers destroying the world and causing pain to the people lies in the hands of the sovereign." This was interpreted as a pointed critique targeting the previous administration and the opposition, going beyond merely urging people to vote. On the morning of the 30th, the second day of early voting, President Lee also wrote on X, "Giving up on voting is giving up on the future of myself and my family, and it is siding with those who harm my life and community." (이 대통령은 본투표일 사흘 전인 31일 새벽 X에 고대 철학자 플라톤의 말이라며 “정치 무관심의 대가는 최악의 저질들에게 지배당하는 것”이라며 이같이 썼다. “훌륭한 사람들이 스스로 통치하기를 거부할 때 받는 가장 큰 벌은 자기보다 못한 자들에게 통치당하는 것”이라는 플라톤의 말을 인용한 것이다. 이 대통령은 “선출된 공직자가 어떤 마음과 자세로 어떻게 하느냐에 따라 세상은 지옥이 될 수도, 천국이 될 수도 있다”며 “투표의 힘은 생각보다 강하다. 선출된 그들이 내 삶을 풍요롭게 만드는 충직한 머슴이 될지, 세상을 파괴하고 국민에게 고통을 주는 악성 지배자가 될지는 주권자의 손에 달려 있다”고 했다. 투표 독려를 넘어 전 정권과 야당을 겨냥한 작심 비판으로 해석됐다. 이 대통령은 사전투표 둘째 날인 지난 30일 아침에도 X에 “투표를 포기하는 것은 나와 가족의 미래를 포기하는 것이고, 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것”이라고 썼다.)

The People Power Party responded, "The president is stepping forward to divide the people when the election landscape looks unfavorable." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a press conference on the 31st, "Lee Jae-myung has long kicked aside the president's duty of election neutrality," and "He has been openly campaigning for the Democratic Party by strolling around the market even up to three days before early voting." He added, "He came out of the polling station holding the marked ballot paper and shook it. It's illegal electioneering, telling people to vote for his candidate. No previous president has acted this recklessly." He also stated, "We must vote to resume Lee Jae-myung's trial," and asked, "Who exactly is the malignant ruler in South Korea right now?" (국민의힘은 “대통령이 나서서 선거판이 불리해지자 국민을 갈라치려는 것”이라고 했다. 장동혁 대표는 31일 기자 간담회에서 “이재명은 대통령의 선거 중립 의무를 걷어찬 지 오래”라며 “사전투표 사흘 전까지 시장을 돌아다니면서 노골적으로 민주당 선거운동을 했다”고 했다. 또 “투표장에서 기표한 투표용지를 들고 나와 흔들었다. 내가 찍은 후보 찍으라는 불법 선거운동”이라며 “역대 어느 대통령도 이렇게 막 나가지는 않았다”고 했다. 그러면서 “반드시 투표해서 이재명 재판을 재개해야 한다”며 “과연 지금 대한민국에 악성 지배자가 도대체 누구인가?”라고도 했다.)

The People Power Party continued its offensive over President Lee's ballot exposure controversy. Previously, President Lee voted early on the first day of early voting, the 29th. After receiving his ballot and entering the voting booth, he came out and approached an election commission official while holding the ballot unfolded. President Lee asked, "This isn't fully stamped; it's only half stamped like this—is that okay?" The official said, "You can't show it," but President Lee replied, "Come here. It's fine." He then asked again, "It's only stamped this much; is that alright? It won't be invalidated, right? Because it's only half stamped." After the official responded, "It's fine," President Lee returned to the booth, marked his ballot, exited, and placed it in the ballot box. (국민의힘은 이 대통령의 투표지 노출 논란에 대한 공세도 이어갔다. 앞서 이 대통령은 사전 투표 첫날인 지난 29일 사전 투표를 했는데, 투표용지를 받아 기표소에 들어간 뒤 다시 나와 선거관리위원회 관리관을 찾았다. 투표지를 접지 않고 들고 있는 상태였다. 이 대통령은 “이게 동그랗게 완전하게 안 찍히고 이런 식으로 반만 찍혔는데 괜찮나요”라고 물었다. 관리관이 “보여주시면 안 된다”고 했지만, 이 대통령은 “이리 와보세요. 상관없으니까”라고 했다. 이 대통령이 “이게 이렇게밖에 안 찍혀서, 괜찮냐고요. 무효가 되거나 그러진 않아요? 반밖에 안 찍혀서”라고 다시 물었다. 관리관이 “괜찮습니다”라고 하자 이 대통령은 기표소로 돌아가 기표한 뒤 나와서 투표함에 투표지를 넣었다.)

On the 30th, the People Power Party filed a complaint with the police against President Lee and the election commission official. Article 167, Paragraph 3 of the Election Law states, "A voter may not disclose their marked ballot paper, and any disclosed ballot paper shall be invalidated." The People Power Party argued, "President Lee disclosed the ballot paper, and the election official processed it as valid, violating election law," adding, "We also filed a complaint against the official for dereliction of duty under criminal law." Chief Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon of the People Power Party said, "This incident is not a simple mistake but a planned, public ballot reveal carried out amid a sense of crisis in the final stages of the election." (국민의힘은 지난 30일 이 대통령과 선관위 관계자를 경찰에 고발했다. 선거법 167조 3항에는 “선거인은 자신이 기표한 투표지를 공개할 수 없으며, 공개된 투표지는 무효로 한다”고 돼 있다. 국민의힘은 “이 대통령은 투표지를 공개했고 선관위 관리관은 이를 유효처리해 선거법 위반”이라며 “관리관은 형법상 직무유기로도 고발했다”고 했다. 국민의힘 최보윤 수석대변인은 “이번 사태는 단순 실수가 아니라 선거 막판 위기감 속에 감행한 기획형 공개 투표”라고 했다.)

However, the Presidential Office maintains the position that "stepping out of the voting booth with the ballot to ask about marking does not invalidate the ballot under election law." The Democratic Party also stated, "The People Power Party's obsession with scrutinizing every move of the president under a microscope to find flaws has crossed the line," adding, "Forcing a controversy that does not exist is itself irresponsible politics." (하지만 청와대는 “투표용지를 들고 기표소 밖으로 나와 기표에 대한 질문을 하는 것은 선거법상 무효가 되지 않는다”는 입장이다. 민주당도 “국민의힘은 대통령 행보 하나하나를 현미경으로 들여다보며 흠집을 내보려는 집착이 도를 넘었다”며 “존재하지도 않는 논란을 억지로 조장하는 행태야말로 무책임한 정치”라고 했다.)

item.title: MB Takes the Mic in Busan’s Haeundae… Park Geun-hye Supports People Power Party at Daegu’s Seomun Market (MB, 부산 해운대서 마이크 잡고… 박근혜, 대구 서문시장서 국힘 지원)
item.description:
Former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye spent the final weekend before the June 3 local elections on May 31 in the key battleground of the Yeongnam region, backing candidates of the People Power Party. (이명박·박근혜 전 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 전 마지막 주말인 31일 여야 최대 격전지인 영남권에 머물며 국민의힘 후보 지원에 나섰다.)

Lee Myung-bak attended a church service in Busan’s Haeundae District that day, joined by Busan Mayor candidate Park Hyung-joon and Park Min-shik, candidate for the Busan North-Gap by-election. At Haeundae Market, Lee took the microphone, saying, “When I was mayor of Seoul, I was also an opposition party mayor. It’s not about who the president is or who the minister is—it’s about who becomes the Busan mayor that significantly impacts Busan’s development. For Busan’s progress, Park Hyung-joon must be elected.” Park Hyung-joon is a pro-Lee figure who served as a senior political affairs secretary at the Blue House during the Lee Myung-bak administration. On June 1, Lee plans to visit Seoul Forest in Seongdong District to meet citizens and indirectly support Seoul Mayor candidate Oh Se-hoon. Seongdong is where Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh has served as district mayor for three terms. <<> Park Geun-hye visited Daegu’s Seomun Market that day, stating, “Daegu is often called a symbol of conservatism, but I know many are struggling due to the difficult local economy. Candidate Choo Kyung-ho is the right person to revive Daegu’s economy.” Park has recently traveled to Busan, Gangwon, and Chungcheong, urging support for People Power Party candidates. <<> Regarding the election support from the two former presidents, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae remarked, “The three former presidents—Yoon Suk Yeol, Park Geun-hye, and Lee Myung-bak—are the ‘prison trio.’ While the main fire of the insurrection is being contained, the embers are still smoldering.” Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae added, “Deploying Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye will backfire. Lee Myung-bak is the main culprit who ruined Busan’s economy.” (이 전 대통령은 이날 부산 해운대구의 한 교회 예배에 참석했다. 박형준 부산시장 후보, 박민식 부산 북갑 보궐선거 후보가 함께했다. 이 전 대통령은 해운대시장을 방문해선 마이크를 잡았다. 이 전 대통령은 “나도 서울시장 때 야당 시장이었다. 대통령이 누구냐, 장관이 누구냐는 것이 문제가 아니고 부산시장이 누가 됐느냐가 부산 발전에 크게 영향을 준다”며 “부산 발전을 위해 박형준 시장이 (당선이) 돼야 한다”고 했다. 박형준 후보는 이명박 정부 청와대 정무수석을 지낸 친이계다. 이 전 대통령은 1일엔 서울 성동구 서울숲을 찾아 시민들과 만나며 오세훈 서울시장 후보를 측면 지원한다. 성동구는 민주당 정원오 후보가 3선 구청장을 지낸 곳이다.)

item.title: Lee Won-taek and Kim Kwan-young in Tight Race… Jeonbuk Early Voting Rate Tops at 35% (이원택·김관영 초접전… 전북 사전투표율 35% 1위)
item.description:
Amid the 6.3 local elections setting a record-high early voting rate, the Jeonbuk gubernatorial race—where Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek and independent candidate Kim Kwan-young are locked in a close contest—recorded the highest early voting rate at 35.05%. In response, Lee’s camp stated, “The Democratic Party’s support base is rallying together,” while Kim’s camp argued, “It reflects public sentiment that they will no longer serve as the Democratic Party’s rubber stamp.” (6·3 지방선거 사전투표율이 역대 최고치를 찍은 가운데, 민주당 이원택 후보와 무소속 김관영 후보가 초접전 양상을 보이고 있는 전북지사 선거 사전투표율이 35.05%로 1위를 기록했다. 이를 두고 이 후보 측은 “민주당 지지층이 총결집 중”이라고 했고, 김 후보 측은 “민주당 거수기를 더는 하지 않겠다는 민심”이라고 했다.)

Following Jeonbuk, the Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Mayoral election had the second-highest early voting rate at 34.17%. Jeonnam had frequently ranked first in early voting rates in past presidential, general, and local elections. However, this time, with the merger of Jeonnam and Gwangju, the top spot was ceded to Jeonbuk. In particular, Jeonbuk’s early voting rate increased by 10.64 percentage points compared to the 2022 local elections. A conservative party official commented, “That shows just how much attention is focused on the Jeonbuk election.” (전북에 이어 전남광주통합시장 선거 사전투표율은 34.17%로 2위였다. 전남은 역대 대선·총선·지방선거 등에서 사전투표율 1위를 차지한 적이 많았다. 하지만 이번엔 전남·광주가 통합되면서 1위 자리를 전북에 넘겨줬다. 특히 전북 사전투표율은 2022년 지방선거 때보다 10.64%포인트나 늘었다. 여권 관계자는 “그만큼 전북 선거에 관심이 쏠린 것 아니겠냐”고 했다.)

Both sides interpreted the results in their favor. After being expelled from the Democratic Party over the ‘proxy payment controversy,’ Kim ran as an independent and has been urging Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, saying, “If I win, Representative Jung should resign.” The Jeonbuk election has escalated into a showdown between Jung and Kim, and various opinion polls showed Kim leading within the margin of error. (양측은 자신들에게 유리한 방향으로 해석했다. 김 후보는 ‘대리비 지급 논란’으로 민주당에서 제명된 뒤 무소속으로 출마했고 정청래 지도부를 향해 “내가 당선되면 정 대표는 사퇴하라”고 해왔다. 전북 선거는 정 대표와 김 후보 간 싸움으로 번졌고, 각종 여론조사에서 김 후보는 오차범위 내 선두였다.)

On May 31, Kim stated, “The highest early voting rate in the nation is a strong expression of will against the arrogance that disrespected the candidates chosen by the province’s residents.” However, Democratic Party lawmaker Han Min-soo, who serves as Jung’s chief of staff, countered, “Kim is misleading people as if this is his victory.” Lee Won-taek’s campaign appealed for support, saying, “Kim could face a nullified election due to illegal cash distribution.” (김 후보는 31일 “전국 최고 사전투표율은 도민이 선택한 후보를 부정한 오만함에 대한 강력한 의사 표시”라고 했다. 하지만 정 대표 비서실장인 한민수 의원은 “김 후보가 자신의 승리인 양 호도하고 있다”고 했다. 이원택 후보 캠프는 “김 후보는 현금 살포로 당선 무효형 가능성이 있다”며 지지를 호소했다.)

The high voter turnout in Jeonnam also sparked various interpretations. As some independent and Jo Kuk Innovation Party candidates performed well in certain local government head elections, some analysts suggested it reflected a backlash against the Democratic Party’s nominations. However, a Democratic Party official stated, “As it is the first election under the Lee Jae-myung administration, the progressive support base has consolidated.” Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae remained in the Honam region throughout the weekend, urging, “To empower President Lee, please vote for ballot number 1, with the mindset of ‘like it or not,’” adding, “We will carry out ‘filial politics’ well for Honam.” (전남 투표율이 높은 것을 두고도 여러 해석이 나왔다. 일부 기초단체장 선거에서 무소속·조국혁신당 후보가 선전하면서 일각에선 민주당 공천에 대한 반발 심리가 작용한 것이라고 했다. 하지만 민주당 관계자는 “이재명 정부 첫 선거로 진보 지지층이 결집한 상태”라고 했다. 정청래 민주당 대표는 주말 내내 호남에 머물며 “이 대통령에게 힘을 실어주시려면 ‘미우나 고우나’ 심정으로 기호 1번에 투표해달라”며 “민주당이 호남에 대한 ‘효도 정치’를 잘하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Oh: "Will Check Lee's Government in State Council" Jeong: "Why Did You Stay Silent During Yoon's Government?" (吳 “국무회의서 李정부 견제” 鄭 “尹정부 땐 왜 침묵했나”)
item.description:
On the 31st, three days before the Seoul mayoral election, candidates from both the ruling and opposition parties clashed over the "Seoul mayor's attendance at the State Council." When Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party said, "I will attend the State Council to keep the Lee Jae-myung government in check," Jeong Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea countered, "Why didn't you speak out properly at the State Council meetings during the Yoon Suk-yeol government?" Both candidates carried out full-scale campaigning across Seoul that day. <<> Candidate Oh held a press conference that day, appealing for support by saying, "Send me to the government's State Council as a 'representative of the citizens.'" The Seoul mayor, who receives minister-level treatment, is the only local government head allowed to attend State Council meetings and exercise the right to speak. Oh stated that he would attend the State Council to propose easing regulations in the capital region and to block the 'dismissal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung.' Referring to Democratic Party candidate Jeong, he called him "a straw man chosen by President Lee Jae-myung" and added, "Seoul needs a protector of citizens' rights now, not a straw man." <<> In response, Candidate Jeong posted a critical message about Oh on Facebook. He asked, "What exactly did you do during the State Council meetings of the Yoon Suk-yeol government? You stayed silent then, but now you claim you will oppose the Lee Jae-myung government at every turn. The Seoul mayor's job in the State Council isn't to trip up the president, but to cooperate in protecting citizens' livelihoods." <<> During his campaign that day, Candidate Jeong said, "If Candidate Oh had kept his promises, there would be no current housing issues or crisis. His incompetence in failing to keep promises is a problem, but the bigger issue is his irresponsibility. Can you forgive an irresponsible mayor who blames others? Please change the mayor." He added, "I will work in close coordination with the president to solve the piled-up housing, transportation, and economic issues one by one." <<> The previous day, Candidate Oh sharply criticized Candidate Jeong's past 'business trip to Cancun, Mexico.' He pressed for the disclosure of specific details, saying, "In the Seoul city government, schedules are made public down to the hour. Did Candidate Jeong release even a single piece of information about that 2-night, 3-day trip?" Oh announced that he would conduct an '88-hour nonstop responsibility campaign' starting from 8 a.m. on the 30th until midnight on June 2nd, when election campaigning ends. (서울시장 선거를 3일 앞둔 31일 여야 후보는 ‘서울시장의 국무회의 배석’을 놓고 충돌했다. 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 “국무회의에 참석해 이재명 정부를 견제하겠다”고 하자, 정원오 더불어민주당 후보는 “윤석열 정부 국무회의에선 왜 제대로 말하지 못했느냐”고 공격했다. 두 후보는 이날 서울 전역을 돌며 총력 유세에 나섰다.)

item.title: South Korea's Wartime OPCON Transfer Race... U.S. Defense Secretary Says "Encouraging, but Balance Needed" (한국 전작권 전환 속도전에… 美국방 “고무적이지만 균형 필요”)
item.description:
U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth evaluated the Lee Jae-myung administration's will to transfer wartime operational control as "encouraging," while simultaneously emphasizing the need for "balance" with U.S. military operational plans. (피트 헤그세스 미국 전쟁부(국방부) 장관이 이재명 정부의 전시작전통제권 전환 의지를 “고무적”이라고 평가하면서, 동시에 미군 작전 계획과의 “균형”을 강조했다.)

During a Q&A session following his speech at the 23rd Asia Security Summit (Shangri-La Dialogue) held in Singapore on the 30th (local time), Secretary Hegseth responded to a question regarding South Korea's wartime OPCON transfer, stating, "It is encouraging (a breath of fresh air) that an ally wants to exercise more control more quickly." Secretary Hegseth mentioned that he had recently discussed the OPCON transfer issue with Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek, adding, "We want to continue to encourage that movement." (헤그세스 장관은 지난 30일(현지 시각) 싱가포르에서 열린 제23차 아시아안보회의(샹그릴라 대화) 연설 후 질의응답에서 한국의 전작권 관련 질문에 답하면서 “동맹국이 더 빨리 더 많은 통제권을 행사하고자 하는 것은 고무적(breath of fresh air)”이라고 했다. 헤그세스 장관은 최근 안규백 국방부 장관과도 전작권 전환 문제를 논의했다며 “우리는 그런 움직임을 계속 장려하고 싶다”고 했다.)

This is interpreted as a positive assessment of the Lee Jae-myung administration's will for OPCON transfer from the perspective of the 'burden-sharing expansion among allies' emphasized by the Trump administration. Regarding South Korea, which has pledged to increase its defense budget to 3.5% of its GDP, Secretary Hegseth said, "If you want to see what burden-sharing looks like, look at South Korea." (이는 트럼프 행정부가 강조하는 ‘동맹국의 부담 확대’란 차원에서 이재명 정부의 전작권 전환 의지를 긍정 평가한 것으로 풀이된다. 헤그세스 장관은 국내총생산(GDP) 3.5%까지 국방비를 늘리기로 약속한 한국에 대해 “책임 분담이 어떤 모습인지 보고 싶다면 한국을 보라”고 했다.)

However, Secretary Hegseth stated regarding the OPCON transfer process, "I think we need to find a balance where the U.S. military's operational plans and the responsibilities that U.S. service members have held for decades are respected." On the same day, U.S. Forces Korea Commander Xavier Brunson said, "What's important is that we not only need the right capabilities at the right place and time, but we also need to reflect our perspective." (다만 헤그세스 장관은 전작권 전환 과정에서 “미군의 작전 계획과 미군 장병들이 수십 년간 지녀온 책임이 존중되는 지점에서 균형(balance)을 찾아야 한다고 생각한다”고 했다. 이날 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 “중요한 것은 우리가 적절한 시기에 적절한 장소에서 적절한 역량을 갖춰야 할 뿐 아니라 우리의 관점도 반영해야 한다는 점”이라고 말했다.)

South Korea sees the timing of the OPCON transfer as "as early as next year," while U.S. Forces Korea views the achievement of the transfer conditions as "as early as the first quarter of 2029." Secretary Hegseth's 'balance' remarks on this day were analyzed as a reminder that coordination between South Korea and the U.S. is necessary. (한국은 전작권 전환 시점을 ‘이르면 내년’으로, 주한 미군은 전환 조건의 달성 시점을 ‘이르면 2029년 1분기’로 보고 있다. 이날 헤그세스 장관의 ‘균형’ 발언을 두고 한미 양국 간 조율이 필요하다는 점을 상기시켰다는 분석이 나왔다.)

◇ Hegseth Praises South Korea, Pressures Allies to 'Increase Defense Spending' (◇헤그세스, 한국 칭찬하며 동맹국에 ‘국방비 증액’ 압박)

In his speech and Q&A at the Asia Security Summit on this day, Secretary Pete Hegseth said, "The United States welcomes the fact that South Korea wants to transfer OPCON," adding, "This will provide more options for both South Korea and the U.S. on the Korean Peninsula in the future, which is a very good thing." He also stated, "South Korea cannot afford to treat war like an academic exercise, so it has continuously invested in its own defense." Our Ministry of National Defense interpreted this remark as having a different nuance from the statement by U.S. Forces Korea that, based on 'condition fulfillment' as agreed upon by South Korea and the U.S., the target for achieving OPCON transfer conditions is the first quarter of 2029. (피트 헤그세스 장관은 이날 아시아안보회의 연설과 질의응답에서 “미국은 한국이 전작권 전환을 원한다는 사실을 환영한다”며 “이는 향후 한반도에서 한미 양국 모두에게 더 많은 선택지를 제공할 것이며, 이는 매우 좋은 일”이라고 했다. 또 “한국은 전쟁을 학문적 연습처럼 취급할 여유가 없기 때문에 자체 방위에 지속해서 투자해 왔다”고 했다. 우리 국방부는 이 발언을 두고 주한미군이 한미 합의대로 ‘조건 충족’에 기초해 2029년 1분기를 전작권 전환 조건 달성 시점으로 언급한 것과 결이 다른 것으로 받아들였다.)

The Lee Jae-myung administration has set a goal of transferring OPCON as early as next year, demonstrating a strong will to complete the OPCON transfer during the current presidential term of both South Korea and the U.S. In response, from the U.S. side, USFK Commander Brunson had sent signals that the transfer could be delayed until after the next U.S. president takes office (January 2029), stating that "political expediency should not outpace conditions." There were also concerns within some U.S. circles that an early OPCON transfer without meeting conditions would inevitably lead to changes, including the dissolution of the South Korea-U.S. Combined Forces Command structure. (이재명 정부는 이르면 내년 전작권 전환을 목표로 내걸며 한미의 현 대통령 임기 중 전작권 전환을 마무리하겠다는 의지가 강하다. 이에 대해 미국 측에선 브런슨 주한미군사령관이 “정치적 편의주의가 조건을 앞질러서는 안 된다”고 하는 등 미국 차기 대통령 취임(2029년 1월) 이후로 미뤄질 수 있다는 메시지가 나왔었다. 미 일각에서는 조건이 충족되지 않은 전작권 조기전환시 한미 연합사 체제의 해체 등 변화가 불가피하다는 우려도 제기되고 있었다.)

Amidst this, as Secretary Hegseth stated that "it is encouraging that an ally wants to exercise more control more quickly," the Ministry of National Defense greeted this with a positive atmosphere. There were also observations that related discussions between the South Korean and U.S. defense authorities may have progressed more than expected. Minister Ahn Kyu-baek, during a briefing with special correspondents after his meeting with Secretary Hegseth on a visit to the U.S. on the 12th, stated regarding Commander Brunson's suggestion of a 'first quarter of 2029 OPCON transfer,' "That is a matter for military authorities; (the early transfer) is a policy and political decision." (이런 와중에 헤그세스 장관이 “동맹국이 더 빨리 더 많은 통제권을 행사하고자 하는 것은 고무적”이라고 밝히자 국방부는 반기는 분위기다. 한미 국방 당국 간에는 관련 논의가 생각보다 진전된 것 아니냐는 관측도 나왔다. 안규백 장관은 지난 12일 방미 중 헤그세스 장관 회담 후 가진 특파원 간담회에서 브런슨 사령관이 제시한 ‘2029년 1분기 전작권 전환’에 대해 “그것은 군사 당국자의 이야기이고, (조기 전환은) 정책적·정치적 결심사항”이라고 했다.)

While answering the OPCON-related question on this day, Secretary Hegseth introduced that he had a lengthy conversation with Commander Brunson on this issue and also discussed it during Minister Ahn's visit to the U.S. Minister Ahn reportedly expressed his gratitude during a separate meeting with Secretary Hegseth on this day for the positive assessment of 'South Korea's rapid OPCON transfer push.' A Ministry of National Defense official stated, "The two ministers will continue close communication on allied issues going forward." (헤그세스 장관은 이날 전작권 관련 질문에 답하면서 자신이 이 문제에 대해 브런슨 사령관과 긴 시간 대화했고, 안 장관 방미 때도 논의했다고 소개했다. 안 장관은 이날 헤그세스 장관과 따로 만난 자리에서 ‘한국의 신속한 전작권 전환 추진’을 고무적으로 평가한 것에 대해 사의를 표했다고 한다. 국방부 관계자는 “양 장관은 앞으로도 동맹 현안에 관한 긴밀한 소통을 이어갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Minister Ahn, after meeting with a U.S. congressional delegation at this Shangri-La Dialogue, conveyed that "I thoroughly communicated to the U.S. lawmakers the gist and content that there would be no difficulty even if OPCON were transferred tomorrow." Minister Ahn also said, "We fully explained our capabilities, including that South Korea and the U.S. agreed in 2020 that 94% of the conditions for OPCON transfer had already been met." However, there are also points raised that simply comparing this with the fulfillment rate from six years ago is unreasonable, given the changed regional security environment due to the advancement of North Korea's nuclear program. (안 장관은 이번 샹그릴라 대화에서 미 상·하원 대표단을 만난 뒤 “내일 전작권이 전환되더라도 아무 어려움이 없다는 취지와 내용을 풍성하게 미 의원들에게 전달했다”고 전했다. 안 장관은 “한미 양국은 2020년에 전작권 전환 조건의 94%가 이미 충족됐다고 합의한 것을 비롯해, 우리의 능력에 대해 충분히 설명했다”고도 했다. 하지만 북핵 고도화에 따른 역내 안보 환경이 달라진 만큼 6년 전 충족치와 단순 비교하는 것은 무리라는 지적도 나온다.)

There are also views cautioning against overinterpretation, given that Secretary Hegseth's remarks originated from the intention that the U.S. would not assume the security of its allies for the purpose of checking China, while simultaneously emphasizing "balance." Secretary Hegseth stated, "The era of the U.S. subsidizing the defense budgets of wealthy countries is over," citing the case of South Korea increasing its defense spending to the U.S. suggested standard of 3.5% of GDP. (헤그세스 장관의 이번 발언이 중국 견제 차원에서 동맹국 안보를 미국이 떠맡지 않겠다는 취지에서 나온 데다 “균형”을 동시에 강조한 만큼 확대 해석을 경계하는 시각도 있다. 헤그세스 장관은 “미국이 부유한 국가들의 국방비를 보조하는 시대는 끝났다”며 한국이 국방비를 미국이 제시한 기준인 국내총생산(GDP)의 3.5% 수준으로 증액한 사례를 언급했다.)

Regarding the controversy sparked by his remarks in a U.S. Army War College podcast interview released on the 22nd, where he said "South Korea is like a dagger from China's perspective," Commander Brunson stated on this day that he was "trying to describe the operational environment we face." Commander Brunson said, "What I was trying to tell the students at the time was how we need to change our perspective and think about where we are positioned." (이날 브런슨 사령관은 지난 22일 공개된 미 육군대학원 팟캐스트 인터뷰에서 자신이 ‘한국은 중국 입장에서 비수(단검) 같은 존재’라고 발언한 것이 논란을 부른 데 대해 “우리가 처한 작전 환경을 설명하려던 것”이라고 했다. 브런슨 사령관은 “제가 당시 (대학원) 학생들에게 하고자 했던 말은, 우리가 어떻게 관점을 바꾸고 우리가 처한 위치를 생각해야 하는지였다”고 했다.)

Commander Brunson had previously described South Korea as "a stationary aircraft carrier floating between Japan and mainland China," and his use of further expressions like 'dagger' recently drew backlash from China, among others. A Blue House official said the previous day, "We are aware of Commander Brunson's recent series of public remarks, and South Korea and the U.S. have been communicating at various levels on all pending issues." There was talk that the Blue House had expressed regret over Commander Brunson's remarks, and that his comments on this day reflected this atmosphere. (브런슨은 그간 한국을 “일본과 중국 본토 사이에 떠 있는 고정된 항공모함”이라고 했는데 이보다 더 나아가 ‘단검’ 등의 표현을 하자 최근 중국 등이 반발했다. 청와대 관계자는 전날 “최근 브런슨 사령관의 일련의 대외 발언에 대해 인지하고 있으며 한미 간에는 제반 현안에 대해 각급에서 소통해 오고 있다”고 했다. 이를 두고 청와대가 브런슨 사령관 발언에 유감을 표명했고, 브런슨 사령관의 이날 발언은 이런 기류를 반영한 것이란 얘기가 나왔다.)

Meanwhile, at the South Korea-Japan Defense Ministers' meeting held on the 30th on the sidelines of the Shangri-La Dialogue, discussions also took place on the 'Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA),' a bilateral pact that allows the two countries to exchange military supplies. Minister Ahn stated, "There were discussions with Japan (on ACSA)," but added, "Since it is a mutual logistical support agreement, it requires the understanding and persuasion of both countries' citizens, and I believe we still need to be cautious." This is the first time under the current administration that our defense authorities have officially acknowledged discussing the ACSA issue with Japan. The Ministry of National Defense stated, "As of now, ACSA is premature and is not being reviewed," indicating no change in the existing government position. (한편, 샹그릴라 대화를 계기로 지난 30일 열린 한일 국방장관 회담에선 양국이 서로 군수 물자를 주고받을 수 있는 국가 간 약속인 ‘상호군수지원협정(ACSA)’에 대한 논의도 진행됐다. 안 장관은 “일본과 (ACSA) 논의가 있었다”면서도 “상호군수 협정이기 때문에 양 국민의 이해와 설득이 필요한 부분이며, 아직은 신중을 기해야 된다고 생각한다”고 했다. 우리 국방 당국이 일본과의 ACSA 문제를 논의했다는 사실을 공식 인정한 것은 현 정부 들어 처음이다. 국방부는 “현재로서 ACSA는 시기상조이며 검토하지 않고 있다”며 기존 정부 입장에 변화가 없다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: DP: "Bolster Lee's Hand" vs. PPP: "Shy Conservatives Rally" (與 “李에 힘 실어줘” 野 “샤이보수 결집”)
item.description:
The early voting turnout for the June 3 local elections was recorded at 23.51%, up 2.89 percentage points (p) from the local elections four years ago. This marks the highest early voting turnout for local elections ever. Regarding this, the Democratic Party of Korea stated it was "a political judgment against the insurrection forces," while the People Power Party claimed it was "a warning from public sentiment against an arrogant power." (6·3 지방선거 사전 투표율이 4년 전 지방선거 때보다 2.89%포인트(p) 오른 23.51%로 집계됐다. 지방선거 사전 투표율로는 역대 가장 높다. 이를 두고 더불어민주당은 “내란 세력에 대한 정치적 심판”이라고 했고, 국민의힘에선 “오만한 권력을 향한 민심의 경고”라고 주장했다.)

On the 31st, the National Election Commission announced, "During the early voting held on the 29th and 30th, 10,498,411 out of a total of 44,649,908 eligible voters participated." The electorate for this local election increased by approximately 340,000 compared to the 2022 local elections, and early voting participants increased by about 1.36 million. Within political circles, analyses were divided over whether this reflects a solidification of the ruling party's lead shown in polls or the emergence of "shy conservative" voters who did not respond to surveys. <<> Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae said on the 31st regarding the high early voting rate, "Many people who believe they need to empower the Lee Jae-myung administration came out to vote." This implies that the Democratic Party's active voter base participated heavily in early voting. In contrast, the People Power Party stated, "'Shy conservatives' are rallying." Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong said, "Voters angered by attempts to overturn the trial to erase the president's crimes and frustration over homeownership are heading to the polls." <<> Polling experts are closely watching whether the conservative base, which distanced itself from politics after the president's impeachment and election defeat, is regrouping. This is because issues surrounding the ruling party's governance—such as the "dismissal of indictment" special counsel law and the handling of the Starbucks controversy—have emerged as election issues, increasing competitive districts. Experts say that if the final turnout exceeds 60%, it can be seen as a consolidation of factions. <<> Kim Sung-soo, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Hanyang University, said, "A high turnout can also be interpreted as one side not giving up on voting. Amid the trend of the 2030 generation becoming more conservative, if they turn out to vote, the existing political formula that a high early voting rate favors the Democrats could crumble this time." <<> ◇ Rival Parties in Parallel Dreams: Both Claim "Many 2030s Came to Polls, Advantageous to Us" <<> With the early voting turnout for the June 3 local elections hitting a record high (23.51%), attention is also focusing on the final turnout. Historical local election turnouts were: 68.4% in 1995, 52.7% in 1998, 48.9% in 2002, 51.6% in 2006, 54.5% in 2010, 56.8% in 2014, 60.2% in 2018, and 50.9% in 2022. <<> In the 2022 local elections, despite a high early voting rate (20.62%), final turnout (50.9%) was relatively low due to poor main voting. That election was held right after the presidential election, where the PPP was ahead in polls, and won 12 out of 17 metropolitan mayoral and gubernatorial seats. However, this election is held one year after the presidential election and carries the nature of an evaluation of the government and ruling party, leading to predictions of high turnout, like in the 2018 local elections (60.2%). <<> Political circles noted that many of the 2030 generation, who typically participate less, were present at early polling stations. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, meeting with reporters on the 30th, the last day of early voting, in a campaign stop in Hadong, South Gyeongsang, said, "Most of the people lining up at polling stations are the younger generation. If many young people have come out, a high early voting rate is at least not unfavorable for the Democratic Party." <<> Conversely, the opposition camp believes that a significant portion of the 2030 generation has become conservative. PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk said about the increase in early voting on the same day, "We will strive to ensure that the 2030 future generation comes out more during the remaining election period." While touring Seoul, Jang appealed, "For the freedom of one cup of coffee, please vote for number 2 on June 3," targeting the regime-level Starbucks boycott movement. <<> Initially, ahead of the June 3 local elections, there was optimism within the Democratic Party, with some saying, "We will sweep even Yeongnam." A notable example was Democratic Party lawmaker Park Jie-won stating in a May MBC interview, "We will win 15 to 1, excluding only North Gyeongsang." However, with variables like the "fabricated indictment" special counsel law, which could lead to the dismissal of President Lee's case, and the Starbucks boycott movement, a conservative rally has emerged, mainly in the Yeongnam region. In the 2024 general election, the Democratic Party was ahead in polls for Busan, but in the vote count, it lost all seats except one to the PPP. This is seen as the effect of a last-minute conservative rally. <<> Yoon Hee-woong, head of the polling agency Opinions, said, "If both early and final turnouts are high, it means that those who were not active in voting, such as the 2030 generation, participated. It remains to be seen whether this will lead to a favorable outcome for conservative candidates." However, if the conservative base rallies, the progressive base may also counter-mobilize. Park Sung-min, head of political consulting firm 'Min', said, "In this election, the Democratic Party's supporter base has relatively high voting intent. If the final turnout exceeds 60%, it should be seen as both sides' support bases having consolidated." <<> According to this early voting result, turnout was highest in South Jeolla (38.95%), followed by North Jeolla (35.05%), Gwangju (27.83%), and Sejong (27.67%). The lowest turnout was in Daegu at 18.65%, followed by Gyeonggi (20.96%), Busan (21.29%), and Incheon (21.62%). <<> Seoul, the main battleground for the two parties, recorded an early voting rate of 23.84%, higher than the 21.2% in the 2022 local elections. By district, Jungnang, Eunpyeong, and Dobong had early voting rates higher than the average, while Gangnam, Seocho, and Songpa were lower. <<> The early voting rate for the parliamentary by-elections held simultaneously with the local elections was recorded at 24.12%, 2.36%p higher than the 21.76% early voting rate for the 2022 by-elections. In major battlegrounds for this by-election, Busan Buk-gu Gap recorded 25.57%, and Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul recorded 18.39%. <<> (31일 중앙선거관리위원회는 “29~30일 진행된 사전 투표에 전체 유권자 4464만9908명 가운데 1049만8411명이 참여했다”고 밝혔다. 이번 지방선거 유권자는 2022년 지방선거와 비교해 34만명가량 증가했고, 사전 투표 참여자는 136만여 명 늘었다. 정치권에선 여론조사에서 나타나는 여당 우위의 구도가 고착되는 것인지, 여론조사에 응답하지 않은 ‘샤이(shy) 보수’ 표심이 나타나는 것인지를 놓고 분석이 엇갈렸다.)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung’s ‘Momentum’, Jung Cheong-rae and Jang Dong-hyuk’s Party Leadership at Stake in Fated Regions (이재명의 ‘기세’, 정청래·장동혁의 ‘당권’ 걸린 운명의 지역 )
item.description:
This election is a battlefield of a massive power reshuffle that will decide the fate of the president and the leadership of both ruling and opposition parties. A big data related-word analysis of ‘election victory’ and ‘election landscape assessment’ collected by SomeTrend from May 11 to 28, 2026, vividly reveals this urgency and complexity. In the big data, the keyword ‘election victory’ is in a tense balance between negative sentiment words like ‘crisis’, ‘criticism’, and ‘controversy’, and words of necessary unity like ‘best effort’, ‘empathy’, and ‘one team’. ‘Election landscape assessment’ is marked by keywords such as ‘complex’, ‘difficult’, and ‘variable’, representing a foggy political landscape where it is impossible to predict even a step ahead. <<> Looking at the trends of various opinion polls already released, the landscape of this local election shows a complex pattern that goes beyond traditional regional dynamics, intertwining high-level political calculations and factional consolidation. Synthesizing the opinion poll results released just before the publication ban took effect, the key battlegrounds nationwide are condensed into the Seoul metropolitan area, the Yeongnam region, the Chungcheong region, and some areas holding National Assembly by-elections. The frequent appearance of related words like ‘drawing attention’, ‘advantage’, and ‘close’ in the big data landscape analysis is due to the increase in areas where razor-thin battles are taking place within the margin of error in opinion polls. <<> The hottest battlefield is the Seoul mayoral election. The incumbent Mayor Oh Se-hoon is running on a platform of stability as a defense mechanism for the People Power Party (PPP), while the Democratic Party (DP), fielding former district mayor and administration expert Jung Won-oh, aims to expand public support for the administration, resulting in a fierce, close-quarters battle within the margin of error. Subtle shifts in public sentiment in some swing districts in the southwestern and southeastern parts of the city are shaking up the entire landscape, leaving even experts hesitant to confidently predict the outcome. <<> Furthermore, among the National Assembly by-elections held concurrently with this local election, Pyeongtaek-eul in Gyeonggi Province and Buk-gu Gap in Busan are serving as barometers for the overall local election landscape. In Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi, the direct involvement of Cho Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, has created a triangular race for supremacy against both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party candidate, resulting in a ultra-tight battle within the margin of error. In Buk-gu Gap, Busan, the emergence of an independent candidate triggered by internal conflict within the opposition party has also created a three-way race with the ruling party candidate, shaking up the flow of public sentiment in the Yeongnam region in multiple layers. The phenomenon of opinion poll results either sharply diverging or maintaining minimal gaps vividly proves why keywords like ‘complex’ and ‘cold-hearted’ ranked highly in the big data sentiment analysis. <<> At the election offices and party member bulletin boards of both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party leadership, strategic directives are being issued nonstop to overcome the ‘crisis’ and achieve a ‘landslide victory’. item.title: “Ha Jung-woo Ignored Citizens” “Han Supporters Assaulted Residents” (“하정우가 시민 무시” “韓 지지자, 주민 폭행”)
item.description:
The war of nerves among candidates running in the June 3 National Assembly by-elections is intensifying. Particularly in Busan's Buk-gu Gap and Gyeonggi's Pyeongtaek-eul, where multi-candidate races are underway, harsh words have been exchanged toward opponents. (6·3 국회의원 재·보궐선거에 출마한 후보들 간 신경전이 거세지고 있다. 특히 다자구도로 치러지는 부산 북갑, 경기 평택을에선 상대를 향한 거친 말이 쏟아졌다.)

Busan Buk-gu Gap independent candidate Han Dong-hoon posted a video lasting about 40 seconds on Facebook on the 30th under the title "Difference in Attitude Toward the People." In the video, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo is seen responding in an agitated voice to a YouTuber questioning suspicions related to his 'Upstage,' saying, "Again, again, again, again. I need time to explain, don't I? Time." Han stated, "Even if someone doesn't support you, ignoring, losing your temper, and rebuking a citizen of the Republic of Korea to their face is not the basic attitude of a politician." <<> In response, Ha fought back by posting a video and photos on Facebook under the title "Buk-gu Resident Assault Incident, Candidate Han Dong-hoon, Answer." This video shows the man from Han's earlier video having a scuffle with citizens. Ha said, "Yesterday, on Deokcheon Youth Street, a shocking incident occurred where a YouTuber supporting candidate Han's side assaulted a Buk-gu resident." He added, "(Han) must immediately apologize to the Buk-gu residents and thoroughly manage his fan club. We absolutely refuse this kind of street-vendor-style politics in our Buk-gu." <<> In Gyeonggi's Pyeongtaek-eul, Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Fatherland Innovation Party candidate Cho Kuk took aim at each other. Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae visited Pyeongtaek on the 30th and, targeting Cho Kuk, said, "A fake Democratic Party candidate is deceiving people as if he were the real one," and "Voting for a fake Democratic Party could lead to the People Power Party winning." <<> In response, Cho Kuk said on the 31st, "Yesterday, the Democratic Party opposed building a larger and stronger democratic reform camp," calling it "a politics of small interests that abandons the greater cause and focuses only on personal politics." The Fatherland Innovation Party has been repeatedly attacking candidate Kim Yong-nam over suspicions of running a loan shark business under a borrowed name, stating, "Kim's apology is a dead ringer for Yoon Seok-youl and Kim Keon-hee's arrogant habit of offering 'dog apologies,'" and called it "Dog Apology Season 2." (부산 북갑 무소속 한동훈 후보는 30일 페이스북에 ‘국민을 대하는 태도 차이’라는 제목으로 약 40초 분량의 영상을 올렸다. 이 영상에서 민주당 하정우 후보는 자신의 ‘업스테이지’ 관련 의혹을 묻는 한 유튜버에게 격앙된 목소리로 “또또또또. 시간을 줘야 해명할 것 아닙니까. 시간을”이라고 답하는 모습이 담겼다. 한 후보는 “자기를 지지하지 않더라도 대한민국 국민을 면전에서 무시하고 화내고 면박 주는 건 정치인의 기본 태도가 아니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: First Large-Scale Firepower Drill Under Lee Administration Excludes U.S. Forces (李정부 첫 대규모 화력훈련, 주한미군은 뺐다)
item.description:
Concerns are arising both within and outside the military that the decision not to invite U.S. forces to the first large-scale firepower drill conducted by the military since the inception of the Lee Jae-myung administration could "send a negative message about the South Korea-U.S. combined defense posture." Typically, U.S. forces have participated in the military's large-scale firepower exercises. (이재명 정부 출범 후 처음 실시된 군의 대규모 화력 훈련에 미군을 초청하지 않은 것을 두고, 군 안팎에서 “한미 연합 방위 태세에 관한 부정적 메시지를 줄 수 있다”는 우려가 나오고 있다. 통상 군의 대규모 화력 훈련엔 미군도 참여했다.)

On the 28th, the military conducted the ‘2026 Joint Firepower Drill,’ involving 27 units from the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps, with approximately 1,400 soldiers. Equipment such as the K9 self-propelled howitzer, K2 tank, and the domestically developed next-generation fighter KF-21 were mobilized. However, no U.S. troops or equipment participated. (군은 지난 28일 육·해·공군 및 해병대 27개 부대, 장병 1400여 명이 참여한 가운데 ‘2026 합동화력훈련’을 실시했다. K9 자주포와 K2 전차, 국산 차세대 전투기 KF-21 등이 동원됐다. 그런데 미군 병력이나 장비는 참가하지 않았다.)

The Ministry of National Defense stated, "This drill was planned as a Korean-led exercise from the initial (preparation) phase in January," adding that it was "prepared under the concept of self-reliant defense, cutting-edge strong military, and a defense industry powerhouse." This indicates that U.S. forces were not invited from the outset. (국방부는 “이번 훈련은 지난 1월 최초 (준비) 착수부터 한국군 주도 훈련으로 계획됐다”며 “자주 국방, 첨단 강군, 방산 강국의 콘셉트 아래 (준비한 것)”이라고 했다. 미군을 처음부터 초청하지 않았다는 설명이다.)

Since 1977, the military has conducted a total of 13 large-scale firepower drills through this year. During the 2023 Combined and Joint Firepower Annihilation Exercise, U.S. F-16 fighters and Gray Eagle drones participated. Similarly, the 2008 Joint Firepower Demonstration, the 2012 South Korea-U.S. Combined Integrated Firepower Combat Training, the 2015 Integrated Firepower Annihilation Exercise, and the 2017 Integrated Firepower Annihilation Exercise all involved U.S. Bradley armored vehicles and Apache helicopters. (군은 지난 1977년부터 올해까지 총 13차례 대규모 화력 훈련을 실시했다. 2023년 연합·합동 화력격멸훈련에선 미군의 F-16 전투기와 그레이이글 무인기 등이 참가했다. 2008년 합동화력시범, 2012년 한미연합통합화력전투훈련, 2015년 통합화력격멸훈련, 2017년 통합화력격멸훈련 때도 미군의 브래들리 장갑차와 아파치 헬기 등이 함께했다.)

In 2018 and 2022, U.S. forces did not participate in the firepower drills, which were reportedly linked to the Korea Defense Industry Exhibition (DX Korea) aimed at promoting South Korean defense equipment. A military source noted, "Except for special cases like those, most exercises have been conducted jointly with U.S. forces." (2018년과 2022년 화력 훈련 때는 미군이 참가하지 않았는데, 한국 방산 무기 홍보를 위한 대한민국방위산업전(DX코리아)과 연계해서 진행됐기 때문인 것으로 알려졌다. 군 소식통은 “그때처럼 특별한 경우가 아니면 대부분 미군과 연합 훈련을 해온 셈”이라고 했다.)

Lim Cheol-gyun, a senior research fellow at the Korea Strategy Research Institute, stated, "In the combined defense system where the South Korean and U.S. militaries jointly respond to North Korean threats, an unusual unilateral exercise could create a negative impression that the cooperation system is faltering." A former high-ranking Army general also commented, "Even to smoothly complete the government's actively pursued transition of wartime operational control, combined exercises that facilitate cooperation between the two militaries should be strengthened. It's difficult to understand why a unilateral exercise was conducted." (임철균 한국전략문제연구소 전문연구위원은 “한·미 양국군이 북한 위협에 공동 대응하는 연합 방위 체제에서, 이례적인 단독 훈련은 공조 체제가 흔들린다는 부정적 인상을 줄 수 있다”고 했다. 한 전직 육군 고위 장성도 “정부가 적극 추진하는 전시작전통제권 전환을 차질 없이 완성하기 위해서라도, 양국군 협조를 돕는 연합 훈련을 강화해야 한다”며 “굳이 단독 훈련을 진행한 것은 이해하기 어렵다”고 했다.)
